User-agent: *
Disallow: /lld/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /Security/login
# Timetable query-string URLs (filtered/paginated) have no SEO value.
# Only the base /*/timetable path belongs in the index.
Disallow: /*/timetable?
# Paginated & faceted list URLs (news, events, position-calls, search).
# These query-string variants are an effectively infinite crawl space:
# bots follow them into phantom pages (observed page= up to ~840000),
# wasting crawl budget and hitting the DB. Real content is reachable via
# clean article URLs + sitemap.xml. The app also hard-404s page>9999
# (FormUtils::validatePagination), but keeping crawlers out is cheaper.
Disallow: /*page=
Disallow: /*acceptCookies=
Disallow: /*?*group=
Disallow: /*?*fromDate=
Disallow: /*?*topics=
Disallow: /*?*Search=
# Algolia-Crawler-Verif: CEDEAB813B74D3E5
Crawl-delay: 2

# Throttle Bingbot — confirmed high-traffic source (52.167.144.147 = msnbot)
# NOTE: a crawler obeys only its single most-specific group, so the
# pagination/filter Disallows from User-agent: * must be repeated here.
User-agent: bingbot
Crawl-delay: 10
Disallow: /lld/
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /Security/login
Disallow: /*page=
Disallow: /*acceptCookies=
Disallow: /*?*group=
Disallow: /*?*fromDate=
Disallow: /*?*topics=
Disallow: /*?*Search=
